Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，有一个老男人叫神农。神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以他决定开始找新的药。他下一天开始爬当地的山脉，找了各种各样的植物。神农试一试每个植物，知道有什么好处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 有一个老男人叫神农：老人，“老男人“ has negative meaning
- 神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服：delete “在古代”, it implies that 神农can travel between 古代 and 现代modern times; 都看到，no了for routine/habit; 别的小镇上的人；生病或者不舒服
- 他下一天开始爬当地的山脉：第二天，当地的大山，山脉is for geography

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 有一个老男人叫神农：有一个叫神农的老人，Put the identifying phrase before the noun with 的. “老人” is also a neutral, suitable term for an older man in this story. [rule: attributive_modifier_de]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的小镇人：小镇上的人，别的 distinguishes people or things from a previously stated one; it cannot mean people in general. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 生病还是不舒服：生病或感到不舒服，还是 normally presents alternatives in a question or an uncertain choice; use 或 to list two possibilities in this statement. [rule: none]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 下一天：第二天，Use 第二天 to mean the next chronological day in a narrative; 下一天 is not the standard expression here. [rule: none]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 找了各种各样的植物：找到了各种各样的植物，找 means “search for,” while 找到 means that the search successfully resulted in finding something. [vocab list]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农在古代每一天：他在古代每一天，Use a pronoun when the name appeared in the immediately previous sentence and no other person competes as the referent. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农试一试每个植物：他试一试每个植物，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character after the previous sentence already used 他. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每一天看到了：每一天看到，A habitual action marked by 每一天 takes the zero particle, not 了, because it is not one completed event. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “老男人” has a negative connotation here, while “老人” is neutral and appropriate.
The phrase needs “别的小镇上的人”; the correction fixes the location structure but incorrectly removes “别的”.
In this affirmative statement, “或者/或” is appropriate rather than “还是” for the alternatives.
“第二天” is the standard expression for the next day in this narrative.
“找了各种各样的植物” can correctly mean that he searched for various plants and does not require “找到.”
A pronoun is expected for this close re-reference, but the shown correction still contains the erroneous redundant “在古代” and is cut off.
After the immediately preceding reference to the same character, “他” is the appropriate close re-reference.
“每一天” expresses a habitual action, so “看到” should not take perfective “了.”
